commands-desc: Walkers admin commands: status, spawn, despawn, reload, config. Players: /walkers me
commands-status-desc: Shows the mod's state, problems in the config file and every loaded walker
commands-spawn-desc: Spawns a walker in the given form (animal, true, or animal-deertype) in front of you or of a named player; from the console, at the world spawn
commands-despawn-desc: Removes every loaded walker, or those within the given radius of you. A removal is not a death: no drops, and it does not count as a kill
commands-reload-desc: Reads ModConfig/walkers.json again and applies it without a restart
commands-config-desc: Shows the settings, one section or one setting, or sets a setting and saves it to ModConfig/walkers.json
commands-me-desc: Shows or changes your own choices: noName, noScreenEffects, noTitles, scareVolume
commands-spawn-none-loaded: No walker entity types are loaded yet. They arrive with the creature's entity JSON.
commands-spawn-unknown-form: No walker form called {0}. Loaded forms: {1}
commands-spawn-not-loaded: The world spawn is not loaded. Name an online player to spawn near them instead.
commands-spawn-no-spot: Found no free ground to stand on there. Try again from another spot.
commands-despawn-radius-needs-position: A radius needs a position; from the console, leave it out to remove every walker
commands-reload-failed: Could not read ModConfig/{0}, so the current settings stay: {1}
commands-config-header: Settings in ModConfig/{0}. Name a section or setting to see more, add a value to set it:
commands-config-unknown: No setting called {0}. Try /walkers config to list them.
commands-config-section: {0} is a section. Name one of its settings to set a value.
commands-me-header: Your choices about what the Walker may do to you. Change one with /walkers me setting value:
commands-me-unknown: No choice called {0}. You can set: {1}
